about: What GHC itself says each module depends on. The `ghc` field is recorded by
`just update-ghc-corpus`, which runs `ghc -M` over the case, and is never
edited by hand: it is the compiler's answer, and it is what
Frontend.Haskell.GhcCorpusSpec judges Deslop's Haskell frontend against.
Everything else is authored. `files` maps each file under the case root to
its literal contents; every case is one library whose only source directory
is `src`. `ghc` lists every dependency between two files of the case, as
`[importer, imported]`, each spelled from the case root.
A `knownGap` names what Deslop does not yet read the way GHC does; the spec
asserts those still differ, so closing one turns its test red.

files.src/A.hs:

import B
